objective: Computation on the saved and fresh maps, with the order-free far sides (GENUS-READ A). Run colour refinement (1-WL) and pair refinement (folklore 2-WL, atomic types in both directions) on the native creation map; test whether lines of different atoms share a colour, and whether pairs within an atom and pairs across atoms ever share a pair colour; as a control, do the same on the yes/no creation relation alone.
status: Proved by exact computation on 191 saved and 86 fresh maps through the order-free far sides: colour refinement mixes lines of two atoms in 87 spaces (14 of 23 Fano trees; symmetry, not an obstruction); pair refinement never mixes pairs within and across atoms (277 of 277), so every automorphism of the native creation map preserves the atoms and 'same atom' is C^3-definable in each space; on yes/no creation alone it mixes in 42, including all 39 obstructed spaces
title: Pair refinement determines the atoms
